New day, new question!

Pick a hero. What single non-character card in that hero’s deck best represents that hero? Why?

posts.name: Donner
posts.cooked: Setback:  Reckless Rush.  Shows him hurting himself to hurt the enemy, but also combos well with Wrong Time and Place to hurt the enemy at practically no cost to himself or at a better return rate of self-damage to enemy damage with High-Risk Behavior.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Guise: Best Card Ever!  This card depicts that Guise is about showing up the other heroes, he has to have all the best stuff, and the flavor text is the prime example of him breaking the fourth wall.  He gets everything out of the card you could want card draw, health, damage, and the option to still play another card.

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked: Ra: Wrathful Gaze.  Although the least powerful card, and least related mechanically, Wrathful Gaze perfectly depicts Ra's godly power and scorn.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Legacy: Heroic Interception - This card shows the lengths Legacy is willing to go protect others as he is sacrificing his own body to stop an incoming missile.
